comparison_acceptance: All exact same-point pairs and three bracketing OpenSSL A/A controls per repetition pass; cluster bootstrap by Q gives a 95% paired log-ratio interval excluding one.
timing_boundary: One supplied public Q and one frozen (a,b) pair per case. Fixture loading, Q-independent curve/group initialization, generator-only OpenSSL warmup, reusable G-table preparation, and scalar-plan compilation are outside online time. OpenSSL globalwarm times Q point setup, first target EC_POINT_mul, and affine output. Joint radix-81 and mixed-76 time Q-table construction, Horner evaluation, and affine output. Each arm verifies the same point.
